evidence: Fingerprints are not accepted as authentication credentials.
Schedule restore separately verifies server-signed manifests and complete execution payload bindings.

findings.recommended_next_step: Record the false-positive disposition for this exact non-password use; preserve SHA256, original bearer authentication and signed execution validation.

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: SECURITY.md; src/server/resources/runners.ts; packages/runner/src/storage.ts; terminal-delivery.ts; schedule-cache.ts signed manifest validation; native build/fixture entrypoints

evidence: Private-payload digest is an integrity/content reference, not an authentication verifier.
Native restore reconstructs the job and verifies its server-signed authorization and private-payload bindings.

Fresh CodeQL assigns alert27 to restorePrivateJob at line227 after helper extraction; it is the same private-payload content-address check previously tracked as alert25. retain serializes the payload and uses its SHA256 as the keyring reference, and restore validates the complete signed execution bindings before returning usable jobs.
counterevidence: The keyring getPassword API returns serialized execution data here, not a user's authentication password.
proof_gaps: Static triage only; no exploit tests performed in this phase.
findings.recommended_next_step: Record the false-positive disposition for this exact non-password use; preserve SHA256, original bearer authentication and signed execution validation.
